caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-length dress with long sleeves and a rounded neckline. The dress is covered in a detailed, dense pattern of vertical stripes made up of various floral motifs in colors such as pink, yellow, white, green, and red, set against a dark background. The fabric appears to be gathered at the neckline and slightly at the cuffs, creating a flowing effect down the length of the dress. There is no visible figure wearing the dress; the head, hands, and feet are not depicted, leaving only the dress itself visible. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or decorations present. The artist’s name, “Edith Magnette,” is written in small text at the lower left corner of the image.
title: Ball Dress
